title: Blueberry and Apple Oats
description: Enjoy waking up to a warming bowl of porridge fresh from the slow cooker! We’ve used a water-bath method to cook them overnight.

ingredients.text: 2 small dessert apples, peeled and cut into 1cm dice
1 tbsp granulated sweetener or caster sugar

steps: Put all the ingredients for the oats into a heatproof bowl and stir. Place in slow cooker and cook on low overnight (4–8 hours).
For the compote: put apples, blueberries, lemon juice, sweetener, cinnamon and water in a small saucepan over a medium-high heat and stir until it begins to bubble.
Reduce the heat and simmer for 10–15 minutes until the apples soften.
Remove from the heat, leave to cool, cover and store in the fridge overnight.
In the morning, divide the oats among bowls, top with the compote and serve.
